updates.content:
Title: Some users may be unable to load their calendar in the Microsoft Teams web application

User impact: Users may be unable to load their calendar in the Microsoft Teams web application.

More info: Affected users may experience extended loading times, and subsequent attempts to load their calendar may succeed.

Current status: We’re reviewing service monitoring telemetry and system logs to isolate the root cause, in order to develop a remediation plan.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to load their calendar in the Microsoft Teams web application may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC
